CustomField.description: Stamped by the Callsign CTI on every Task it creates, naming what created it (for example "Power Dialer Follow-Up" or "Call Log"). Blank means the task was created by a person or by another system. Do not edit by hand.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically by the CTI. Blank means a person created this task.
CustomField.label: CTI Origin
